text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide conquered the Kikuka-sho. 
Not with a formula "not to lose," but with 
a "formula to win," she grasped glory for 
the first time.

Biwa Hayahide rejoiced, her emotions laid 
bare. Visiting the waiting room to ask for 
a rematch, Narita Taishin widened her eyes 
at the unfamiliar sight of her friend.

The two promised their next battle would 
be the Tenno Sho (Spring). With a bright, 
confident smile, Biwa Hayahide declared 
she was going for the win.
